import warnings, torch
from test_compose_pair_driver import _build, _batch
from unittest.mock import patch
rows=[]
for n in range(12):
 m=_build('<composeTemperature>2</composeTemperature>')
 batch=_batch(m)
 programs=[]
 with patch.object(m, '_advance_when_time', lambda: None):
  for _ in range(2):
   with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter('ignore')
    m.runBatch(train=False,batchSize=4,batch_override=batch)
   programs.append(m._derivation_program()[1].detach().clone())
   m.End()
   m.symbolSpace.soft_reset()
 rows.append(bool(torch.equal(*programs)))
 m.End()
 m.symbolSpace.soft_reset()
print('IDENTICAL_PROGRAMS_WITH_FIXED_CLOCK', rows)
assert all(rows)
